decision.reason: [ev-18f64e30ab1c] is a one-line release highlight. It only says that remote cluster authentication with Workload Identity is now supported for Kustomization and HelmRelease. It names no spec field, provider value or setting that turns the feature on. It also does not say whether existing remote-cluster (kubeconfig) setups are affected. That is not enough to write a declarative applicability condition, so we need the API/spec documentation or the changelog entry that names the configuration fields involved.
